personalInfo.bio: Frontend-focused Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience specializing in React, TypeScript, and web performance. Actively expanding into Full Stack architecture by building scalable Node.js services, with a core professional focus on Core Web Vitals, System Design, and zero-runtime CSS.
personalInfo.detailedBio: I am a Software Engineer with over 6 years of professional experience, currently specializing in Frontend Architecture and Performance. While my foundation is deeply rooted in React, TypeScript, and state management (Redux, Zustand, React Query), my personal projects involve building full-stack applications using Node.js and Express to bridge the gap toward System Design. At the enterprise level, I focus on optimizing Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), establishing robust private NPM libraries, and implementing clean, component-based architectures. My engineering philosophy prioritizes a deep understanding of browser internals and the event loop over surface-level pattern matching, ensuring my code is scalable, reliable, and strictly typed.

blog.title: Productify: Full-Stack TypeScript Product Platform
blog.excerpt: A real-world PERN-style build where I implemented end-to-end auth with Clerk, ownership-safe product/comment CRUD, and cache-aware React Query flows to keep UX fast without excessive refetching.
blog.content: Productify is one of my real full-stack projects. What makes it special is the combination of strict TypeScript across frontend and backend, auth sync from Clerk to PostgreSQL, authorization checks for product ownership, Drizzle relation-based reads, and cache-first mutation patterns for delete/create flows. I also refactored UI into reusable compound components and improved type safety by replacing broad partial models with stricter write types. Repository: https://github.com/sk-izsk/productify
